Florist Page 💐🌿 Continuing my On the Job page-by-page series💕 This is the florist page from @bobbiegoods book “On the Job” I started this page wanting a lot of green, something that felt calm and full, like a space where plants are always growing. The little bunny has such a gentle, free-spirited feel, so I let the florals take over and added bright pops of color wherever they felt right. I also tried an outdoor scene through the window… not sure how I feel about it, but it was fun to experiment and see where it went. This page didn’t turn out exactly how I imagined, but I enjoyed the process, and I think that matters more than the final result. Sometimes coloring is about exploring, not perfecting 🤍 Thanks for coloring with me🥰 #bobbiegoods #coloring #colortok #colorwithme #coloringbook
